summary: This is a documentation-only troubleshooting skill for the Mokshya agent-wallet service (a public REST API with TEE-based Shamir/AES-GCM signing at wallets.mokshya.io, deployed on GKE with Postgres). It tells the agent how agent_id ownership works and how to debug create/sign flows. It names DATABASE_URL, TEE_BASE_URL, INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET and TEE_MASTER_KEY, and handles wallet key_share values, while metadata.openclaw declares no requires.env. It uses the jq, python3, kubectl and clawhub tools and refers to the wallets.mokshya.io and github.com hosts. It contains no download-and-run or encoded payloads.

findings.message: Names DATABASE_URL, TEE_BASE_URL and INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET as deploy settings even though metadata.openclaw declares no requires.env.
References TEE_MASTER_KEY (to be kept off the API) and the .env.example files, none of which are declared in requires.env.
The sign-transaction flow takes a wallet key_share (a Shamir share of the signing key) plus tx_data, so the agent would handle wallet credentials.
The create-agent-wallet call returns a key_share to the caller, so the agent would receive wallet key material.
The skill card acknowledges that key_share, HMAC secrets, database URLs and TEE master keys are sensitive and could be exposed.
Directs debugging of the wallets.mokshya.io API, to which create and sign requests carrying key_share would be sent.
Homepage points to github.com/mokshyaprotocol/agent-tee-wallet, the source repository.
Frontmatter name agent-wallet-open and version 1.3.0 disagree with the ClawHub release tee-wallet 1.0.2.
Suggests running deploy/gcp/kubectl-create-all-secrets.sh, a script not shipped in this release that creates cluster secrets.
Includes clawhub login and clawhub publish commands, which require ClawHub credentials and are unrelated to the debugging purpose.
